instruction: Fix `merge_sorted` in `seqops/merge.py` (and the shared comparator it relies on) so it produces ascending output and keeps the right list's remaining elements. The shared comparator `default_compare` in `seqops/_utils.py` is inverted and the tail-extend for the right list was dropped, so merges come out descending and truncated.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/seqops/_utils.py b/seqops/_utils.py
--- a/seqops/_utils.py
+++ b/seqops/_utils.py
@@ -7,4 +7,4 @@
     Returns a negative int when ``a < b``, zero when equal, and a positive int
     when ``a > b`` (mirroring the legacy ``cmp`` builtin).
     """
-    return (a < b) - (a > b)
+    return (a > b) - (a < b)
diff --git a/seqops/merge.py b/seqops/merge.py
--- a/seqops/merge.py
+++ b/seqops/merge.py
@@ -15,4 +15,5 @@
             result.append(right[j])
             j += 1
     result.extend(left[i:])
+    result.extend(right[j:])
     return result
